repository.name: @webex/plugin-team-memberships
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.teamMemberships that manages Webex team memberships through the Webex REST API team/memberships resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs the caller's membership object (teamId plus personId or personEmail, optionally isModerator), get and remove take a membership object or its id, list sends its options as the query and resolves a webex-core Page, update PUTs the whole membership object, and remove resolves undefined on 204. Each method sends one request through webex.request and resolves the response; nothing is validated, cached, persisted, or logged.

team-memberships-public-sdk.summary: Published npm package (public plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations are published. Importing it registers TeamMemberships as public plugin 'teamMemberships' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default TeamMemberships class. webex.teamMemberships exposes create, get, list, update, and remove; specified in src/docs/README.md.

hydra-team-memberships-http.source: Webex REST API team/memberships resource (catalog service name hydra, reached through service: 'hydra' in src/team-memberships.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
hydra-team-memberships-http.summary: POST /team/memberships with the caller's membership body; GET /team/memberships/<id> with no query; GET /team/memberships with the caller's options as the query answering a paged {items} with Link headers; PUT /team/memberships/<id> with the whole membership body; DELETE /team/memberships/<id> answering 204. A membership carries id, teamId, personId, personEmail, isModerator, and created.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-013, MOD-014, MOD-027, MOD-028, MOD-043, MOD-048)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerPlugin keys a public plugin by its raw name (teamMemberships, first registration wins) and adds webex.<name> to later instances; WebexPlugin supplies webex and request, and request is the one entry for plugin HTTP traffic, resolving service hydra through the catalog and turning failure statuses into WebexHttpError, whose message names the method, service, and resource.

webex-core-page.summary: new Page(res, webex) stores the body items and parsed Link headers; next and previous request the linked URL and resolve a new Page; iteration yields items in order.
